About Tiny babies
Lovingly handcrafted to bring family play to life, our Tiny babies are made to pair perfectly with Tiny dolls to create the most heartwarming hand-knit families.
Every heirloom-quality Tiny baby is a work of art, hand-knit from natural Peruvian cotton yarn and filled with the teeniest, most thoughtful details. At just under 2.5” tall, each one comes nestled in a magical wildflower bed, ready to bring joy from the moment they arrive.
With eight impossibly adorable Tiny babies to choose from, you and your little one will love collecting them all!
Choose any two Tiny dolls and get a free Tiny baby ($25 value). It’s as simple as that! Mix and match to your hearts content. The only way to get them is FREE!
Every tiny baby is handmade and will slightly vary. We hope you’ll treasure the special details that make your Tiny baby one-of-a-kind.
Fabric and Features:

Hand knit doll with premium 100% cotton, non-toxic, yarn
Safe + non-toxic: Tiny dolls US + Canadian safety standard certified newborn and Tiny homes are safety certified 3+
Handmade in Peru using sustainable, fair trade practices
Tiny babies are approximately 2.5” in height
High stitch count for softness and durability
Stuffed with hypoallergenic polyfill
Every Tiny wildflower bed is made of premium FSC-certified, environmentally conscious materials
